## Background

Adds a community provider page for [`kavel-ai-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/kavel-ai-provider), an image provider (ImageModelV4) for Kavel AI. It works with `generateImage` and needs no API key on the free tier.

## Summary

- New page `content/providers/05-community-providers/56-kavel.mdx`
- Listed in `02-providers-and-models.mdx` under community providers
